# Perra Home Loans (perraloans.com)

> Perra Home Loans is the consumer home loan website of My Bridge Loans Corporation, a California mortgage broker in Fountain Valley, Orange County. Licensed broker Jevon Perra arranges purchase, refinance, cash-out refinance, HELOC and reverse mortgage loans in California. Powered by My Bridge Loans (https://mybridge.loans), which funds private-money bridge loans.

## Key facts
- Brand: Perra Home Loans. Company: My Bridge Loans Corporation (NMLS #2869596). Broker: Jevon Perra (NMLS #1006038, CA DRE #01716773)
- Location: Fountain Valley, California. Consumer home loans in California only
- Contact: 949-463-9898, jevon@mybridge.loans, https://perraloans.com/#contact
- In lending since 2004. Jevon runs each loan himself and answers his own phone; same-day replies
- Programs: conventional, FHA, VA, jumbo, first-time buyer and down payment assistance, bank statement (non-QM) for self-employed, second homes, rate and term refinance, cash-out refinance, HELOC, reverse mortgage (HECM and HECM for Purchase)
- Not offered: construction or ground-up loans
- Bridge loans for real estate investors: My Bridge Loans (https://mybridge.loans)
